function resize(){const cw=canvas.clientWidth||innerWidth,ch=canvas.clientHeight||innerHeight;const mobile=document.body.classList.contains("touch-ui"),zoom=mobile?(cw<ch?.78:.88):1;W=cw/zoom;H=ch/zoom;const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,mobile?1.25:1.5);D=dpr*zoom;canvas.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(D,0,0,D,0,0);resetJoy()}addEventListener("resize",resize);resize();
// Offline original chiptune score and synthesized recycling effects.
let masterBus=null,musicBus=null,effectsBus=null,musicVolume=.38,effectsVolume=.65,musicStep=0,nextBeat=0,musicActive=false;
const effectTimes={};
function initAudio(){try{if(!audio){audio=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();masterBus=audio.createGain();musicBus=audio.createGain();effectsBus=audio.createGain();const limiter=audio.createDynamicsCompressor();musicBus.connect(masterBus);effectsBus.connect(masterBus);masterBus.connect(limiter);limiter.connect(audio.destination);masterBus.gain.value=.65;musicBus.gain.value=musicVolume;effectsBus.gain.value=effectsVolume}if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume().catch(()=>{});return true}catch{return false}}
function voice(freq,dur=.12,vol=.1,type='triangle',bus=effectsBus,when=0,end=null){if(!audio||!bus||!sound)return;const t=when||audio.currentTime,o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(25,freq),t);if(end)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(25,end),t+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.0002,vol),t+.008);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(bus);o.onended=()=>{o.disconnect?.();g.disconnect?.()};o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+.02)}
function tone(freq=500,dur=.08){if(sound&&initAudio())voice(freq,dur,.10,'triangle',effectsBus,0,freq*.65)}
function sfx(id){if(!sound||!initAudio())return;const now=audio.currentTime,limits={collect:.11,magnet:.55,drone:.16,scan:.12,compress:.16,shock:.25,charge:.4};if(now-(effectTimes[id]??-99)<(limits[id]||.07))return;effectTimes[id]=now;
const patterns={start:[392,523,659,784],level:[523,659,784],evolve:[392,523,659,784,1047],boss:[165,156,147,131],win:[523,659,784,1047,784,1047],lose:[330,294,247,196],repair:[440,554,659]};
if(patterns[id]){patterns[id].forEach((f,i)=>voice(f,id==='boss'?.22:.18,.12,id==='boss'?'sawtooth':'triangle',effectsBus,now+i*.105));return}
const tones={scan:[1100,.12,.07,'sine',400],fan:[160,.25,.07,'sawtooth',65],magnet:[190,.15,.055,'sine',260],drone:[740,.09,.06,'triangle',1200],solar:[330,.35,.12,'sine',990],network:[880,.14,.065,'square',440],compress:[120,.23,.16,'triangle',35],collect:[1320,.07,.065,'sine',1760],hurt:[130,.18,.12,'sawtooth',50],shock:[180,.16,.08,'square',700],charge:[240,.17,.065,'triangle',500]};const v=tones[id];if(v)voice(v[0],v[1],v[2],v[3],effectsBus,now,v[4])}
function setSound(enabled){sound=enabled;if(sound)initAudio();if(masterBus)masterBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(sound?.65:0,audio.currentTime,.025);$('sound').textContent='소리 '+(sound?'ON':'OFF');$('sound').setAttribute('aria-label',sound?'소리 끄기':'소리 켜기');$('sound').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(sound));nextBeat=0}
function updateMusic(){if(!audio||!musicBus)return;const active=sound&&mode==='play';if(active!==musicActive){musicActive=active;musicBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(active?musicVolume:0,audio.currentTime,.04);nextBeat=0}if(!active)return;const now=audio.currentTime;if(!nextBeat||nextBeat<now-.25)nextBeat=now+.02;
const boss=s&&s.enemies.some(e=>e.boss&&e.hp>0),tempo=boss?144:122,stepTime=60/tempo/4;
// C major / A minor / F major / G major, eight-bar melodic phrase.
const roots=[48,45,41,43],melody=[72,-1,76,79,76,-1,74,72,67,-1,72,74,76,-1,79,76,69,-1,72,76,79,-1,76,72,69,-1,67,69,72,-1,76,74];
const hz=n=>440*Math.pow(2,(n-69)/12);
let safety=0;while(nextBeat<now+.12&&safety++<8){const step=musicStep%16,bar=Math.floor(musicStep/16)%4,root=roots[bar],t=nextBeat;
if(step%4===0)voice(hz(root),stepTime*2.8,.14,'triangle',musicBus,t);
if(step%2===0){const chord=[0,bar===1?3:4,7,12];voice(hz(root+12+chord[(step/2)%4]),stepTime*1.4,.055,'sine',musicBus,t)}
const note=melody[musicStep%melody.length];if(note>=0&&step%2===0)voice(hz(note+(boss?12:0)),stepTime*1.65,.065,'triangle',musicBus,t);
if(step%4===0)voice(100,.10,.17,'sine',musicBus,t,32);
if(step%8===4){voice(190,.07,.065,'triangle',musicBus,t,70);voice(2400,.035,.025,'square',musicBus,t,500)}
if(step%2===1)voice(5100,.025,.012,'square',musicBus,t,2900);
nextBeat+=stepTime;musicStep++}}
function audioSettings(){return '<div class="help"><label>배경음악 <input id="musicvol" aria-label="배경음악 음량" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="'+Math.round(musicVolume*100)+'"></label> <label>효과음 <input id="effectsvol" aria-label="효과음 음량" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="'+Math.round(effectsVolume*100)+'"></label><div class="small">상단 소리 버튼으로 전체 음소거 · 일시정지 시 음악도 정지</div></div>'}
function bindAudioSettings(){if($('musicvol'))$('musicvol').oninput=e=>{musicVolume=Number(e.target.value)/100;if(musicBus)musicBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(musicActive?musicVolume:0,audio.currentTime,.03)};if($('effectsvol'))$('effectsvol').oninput=e=>{effectsVolume=Number(e.target.value)/100;if(effectsBus)effectsBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(effectsVolume,audio.currentTime,.03)}}
function tell(t){if(document.body.classList.contains('touch-ui'))$('toast').style.top=Math.ceil($('hud').getBoundingClientRect().bottom+10)+'px';$('toast').textContent=t;$('toast').hidden=false;toastTime=4}
function overlay(html){$('overlay').innerHTML='<section class="sheet">'+html+'</section>';$('overlay').classList.remove('off');if(!document.body.classList.contains('touch-ui'))$('overlay').querySelector('button')?.focus({preventScroll:true})}
const portrait='<img alt="리퍼 노트북 주인공" style="width:min(100%,420px);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 22px #0005)" src="'+PLAYER_DATA+'">';
function menu(){mode='menu';s=null;clearKeys();$('toast').hidden=true;overlay('<div class="hero"><div><div class="eyebrow">A SECOND LIFE. A NEW ADVENTURE.</div><h1>RE:BOOT<br><em>EARTH</em></h1><h2 style="font-size:22px">리퍼 노트북의 두 번째 시작</h2><p>점검 완료. 수리 완료. 다시 활약할 시간.<br>자원을 회수하고 공격 스킬 6종까지 성장시켜<br>강해지는 쓰레기 몬스터로부터 6분 동안 센터를 지켜주세요.<br>최종 보스는 5분에 등장합니다.</p><span class="tag">이동만 조작 · 공격은 자동 · BGM / 효과음</span><div class="actions"><select id="difficulty" aria-label="난이도"><option value="easy">체험 · 긴급 수리 1회</option><option value="normal">일반 · 생존에 도전</option></select><button class="primary" id="start">전원 켜기 →</button></div></div><div class="heroart">'+portrait+'<div class="center small">RE:01 / REFURBISHED & READY</div></div></div><div class="foot"><span><span class="desktop-hint">WASD / 방향키 이동 · 1 / 2 / 3 강화 선택</span><span class="mobile-hint">화면을 밀어 이동 · 강화 카드를 터치</span></span><button id="helpbtn">조작 방법</button><span>MOBILE EDITION · V3</span></div><div id="helpbox" hidden class="help">종이박스 괴물은 느리지만 튼튼한 일반 적입니다. 일반 괴물 6종은 시작부터 모두 등장합니다. 소주병 괴물은 단단한 적입니다. 폐타이어 괴물은 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 굴러 돌진합니다. 점선 방향을 보고 옆으로 피하세요. 폐건전지 괴물은 깜빡인 뒤 주변에 전기 공격을 합니다. 노란 원 밖으로 피하세요. 분리배출 스캔으로 시작합니다. 스캔·자기장·정화 바람·압축·수리 신호·태양광·회수 드론, 환경 스킬 10종을 조합하세요. 재생 플라스틱 파쇄탄·순환 회전 디스크·녹색 복원 씨앗탄이 추가되었습니다. 공격은 자동입니다. 바닥의 빛나는 자원을 모으면 업그레이드를 선택할 수 있어요.<br>공격 스킬 6종 + 부품 4종까지 장착 가능. 시간이 흐르면 적의 체력과 공격력이 점점 상승합니다. 무기 Lv.5 + 연결 부품 Lv.3이면 자동 진화!<br>ESC로 일시정지합니다. 다른 창으로 이동하면 자동 정지합니다. 터치 기기는 전투 화면의 빈 곳을 누른 채 원하는 방향으로 밀면 이동합니다. 손을 떼면 멈춥니다.<br>게임 속 장비 효과는 가상의 설정입니다. 점검·수리·재사용의 가치를 표현합니다.</div>');$('start').onclick=()=>start($('difficulty').value);$('helpbtn').onclick=()=>{$('helpbox').hidden=!$('helpbox').hidden}}
function start(diff='easy'){setSound(sound);musicStep=0;nextBeat=0;Object.keys(effectTimes).forEach(k=>delete effectTimes[k]);s={t:0,x:0,y:0,hp:100,maxhp:100,inv:1,lv:1,xp:0,need:8,kills:0,collected:0,rerolls:2,revive:diff==='easy',diff,items:{laser:1},evolved:{},cool:{},enemies:[],bullets:[],gems:[],fx:[],recycling:[],zones:[],drops:[],spawn:0,id:0,boss1:false,boss2:false,phase:0};mode='play';$('overlay').classList.add('off');clearKeys();tell('점검 완료 · RE:01 출동! 빛나는 자원을 모으세요.');sfx('start');hud()}
function resetJoy(){joy.x=joy.y=0;joy.id=null;const el=$("joystick");if(el){el.classList.remove("active");el.style.left="";el.style.top="";el.style.bottom="";$("stick").style.transform="translate(-50%,-50%)"}}function clearKeys(){Object.keys(keys).forEach(k=>keys[k]=false);resetJoy()}function time(t){return Math.floor(t/60).toString().padStart(2,'0')+':'+Math.floor(t%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}
function available(){return Object.keys(defs).filter(k=>{const d=defs[k];if(k==='heal')return false;if((s.items[k]||0)>=d.max)return false;return s.items[k]||Object.keys(s.items).filter(i=>defs[i].kind===d.kind).length<(d.kind==='w'?MAX_WEAPONS:MAX_PARTS)})}
function cards(){const pool=available(),out=[];const owned=pool.filter(k=>s.items[k]);if(owned.length){const k=owned[Math.floor(Math.random()*owned.length)];out.push(k);pool.splice(pool.indexOf(k),1)}while(out.length<3&&pool.length){const weighted=pool.flatMap(k=>Array(Object.keys(s.items).some(w=>defs[w].part===k)?4:1).fill(k));const k=weighted[Math.floor(Math.random()*weighted.length)];out.push(k);pool.splice(pool.indexOf(k),1)}while(out.length<3)out.push('heal');choices=out;overlay('<div class="eyebrow">RE:01 / SYSTEM UPGRADE</div><h2>다음 가능성을 선택하세요.</h2><p>LV. '+s.lv+' · 회수한 자원으로 센터의 장비 지원을 받습니다.</p><div class="cards">'+out.map((k,i)=>{const d=defs[k],n=s.items[k]||0;return '<button class="card" data-choice="'+i+'"><span class="num">'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="small">'+(d.kind==='w'?'공격 장비':d.kind==='p'?'노트북 부품':'수리 지원')+'</span><strong>'+d.name+'</strong><p>'+d.desc+'</p><small>'+(k==='heal'?'내구도 회복':(n?'Lv.'+n+' → '+(n+1):'새 장비 · Lv.1')+(d.part?' · '+defs[d.part].name+' Lv.3과 진화':''))+'</small></button>'}).join('')+'</div><div class="row"><span class="small">게임 시간이 멈춰 있습니다 · 카드 선택</span><button id="reroll" '+(!s.rerolls?'disabled':'')+'>다시 뽑기 ('+s.rerolls+')</button></div>');document.querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>choose(+b.dataset.choice));$('reroll').onclick=()=>{if(s.rerolls){s.rerolls--;cards()}}}
function levelup(){if(mode==='play'&&s.xp>=s.need){s.xp-=s.need;s.lv++;s.need=Math.floor(8+s.lv*2.4);mode='upgrade';clearKeys();cards();sfx('level')}}
function choose(i){if(mode!=='upgrade'||!choices[i])return;const k=choices[i];if(k==='heal'){s.hp=Math.min(s.maxhp,s.hp+30);sfx('repair')}else{s.items[k]=(s.items[k]||0)+1;if(k==='power'){s.maxhp+=25;s.hp=Math.min(s.maxhp,s.hp+25)}}checkEvolution();mode='play';$('overlay').classList.add('off');hud();levelup()}
function checkEvolution(){for(const k of Object.keys(s.items)){const d=defs[k];if(d.part&&s.items[k]===5&&s.items[d.part]===3&&!s.evolved[k]){s.evolved[k]=true;tell('진화 완료 · '+d.evo);ring(s.x,s.y,160,'#d9ff92');sfx('evolve')}}}
function pause(){if(mode==='play'){mode='pause';clearKeys();overlay('<div class="eyebrow">SYSTEM STANDBY</div><h2>잠시 쉬어가요.</h2><p>센터 복구와 전투 시간이 멈췄습니다.</p><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="resume">계속하기</button><button id="restart">처음부터</button><button id="home">시작 화면</button></div>');$('overlay').querySelector('.sheet').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',audioSettings());bindAudioSettings();updateMusic();$('resume').onclick=resume;$('restart').onclick=()=>start(s.diff);$('home').onclick=menu}else if(mode==='pause')resume()}
function resume(){if(sound)initAudio();mode='play';nextBeat=0;$('overlay').classList.add('off');clearKeys()}
function finish(win){mode=win?'win':'lose';clearKeys();const evo=Object.keys(s.evolved).map(k=>defs[k].evo).join(' · ')||'아직 없음';overlay('<div class="eyebrow">'+(win?'MISSION COMPLETE':'PROTECTION MODE')+'</div><h2>'+(win?'RE:BOOT 완료!':'잠시 멈췄을 뿐, 끝난 건 아니에요.')+'</h2><p>'+(win?'다시 켜진 노트북이, 더 많은 기기의 내일을 지켰습니다.<br>고쳐 쓰는 선택, 계속되는 가능성.':'안전 보호 모드로 전환했습니다.<br>다시 정비하고 새로운 장비 조합으로 출발해 보세요.')+'</p><div class="stats"><div class="small">방어 시간<b>'+time(s.t)+'</b></div><div class="small">센터 복구<b>'+Math.floor(s.t/3.6)+'%</b></div><div class="small">처리한 폐기물<b>'+s.kills+'</b></div><div class="small">회수 자원<b>'+s.collected+'</b></div><div class="small">최종 레벨<b>'+s.lv+'</b></div><div class="small">진화 장비<b>'+Object.keys(s.evolved).length+'</b></div></div><p>진화: '+evo+'</p><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="again">다시 출동하기</button><button id="home">시작 화면</button></div>');$('again').onclick=()=>start(s.diff);$('home').onclick=menu;sfx(win?'win':'lose');updateMusic()}
function combatScale(t=s.t){const minute=Math.max(0,Math.min(WIN_TIME,t))/60;return {hp:1+.13*minute+.033*minute*minute,attack:1+.13*minute+.019*minute*minute};}
function damage(n){if(s.inv>0)return;s.hp-=n*combatScale().attack*(s.diff==='easy'?.6:1)*(1-(s.items.armor||0)*.12);s.inv=.65;sfx('hurt');if(s.hp<=0){if(s.revive){sfx('repair');s.revive=false;s.hp=s.maxhp*.65;s.inv=4;tell('긴급 수리 완료! 내구도 65% 복원 · 이번 임무 마지막 수리');aoe(s.x,s.y,230,150,150);ring(s.x,s.y,230,'#ccfc9c')}else{s.hp=0;finish(false)}}}
function spawn(type,boss=false){if(s.enemies.length>=160&&!boss)return;const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r=Math.hypot(W,H)/2+70;const base=type===11?{hp:44,v:29,r:18}:type===10?{hp:38,v:40,r:18}:type===7?{hp:30,v:38,r:18}:type===8?{hp:34,v:39,r:16}:type===9?{hp:30,v:42,r:17}:[{hp:16,v:43,r:13},{hp:10,v:79,r:12},{hp:48,v:30,r:19},{hp:26,v:55,r:14},{hp:36,v:42,r:16}][type%5];let e={...base,id:++s.id,type,x:s.x+Math.cos(a)*r,y:s.y+Math.sin(a)*r,hp:Math.ceil(base.hp*combatScale().hp),max:Math.ceil(base.hp*combatScale().hp),tick:Math.random()*3,hazard:0,hit:0,boss,charge:0,dx:0,dy:0,roll:0,shock:0};if(boss){e.hp=e.max=Math.round((type===5?1900:4800)*(1+(combatScale().hp-1)*.55));e.r=42;e.v=32;e.x=s.x+Math.min(W*.42,400);e.y=s.y-160;sfx('boss');tell(type===5?'경고 · 비닐봉지 괴물 접근!':'최후의 공세 · 폐기물 집게 로봇 접근!')}s.enemies.push(e)}
function ring(x,y,r,c){if(s.fx.length<100)s.fx.push({kind:'ring',x,y,r,c,life:.45,max:.45})}function beam(x,y,tx,ty,c){if(s.fx.length<100)s.fx.push({kind:'beam',x,y,tx,ty,c,life:.15,max:.15})}
function hit(e,n){if(e.hp<=0)return;e.hp-=n;e.hit=.08;if(e.hp<=0){s.kills++;effect('recycle',{x:e.x,y:e.y,r:e.r,c:'#b6f36b'},.65);const baseValue=e.boss?70:e.type===2?3:e.type===4?3:([7,8,9,10,11].includes(e.type))?3:2;const value=Math.max(1,Math.round(baseValue*(1+Math.floor(s.t/90)*.18)));const g={x:e.x,y:e.y,v:value};if(s.gems.length<350)s.gems.push(g);else{const target=s.gems.reduce((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-g.x,a.y-g.y)<Math.hypot(b.x-g.x,b.y-g.y)?a:b);target.v+=value}if(e.boss)s.drops.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,type:'box'});else if(Math.random()<.012&&s.drops.length<10)s.drops.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,type:'repair'})}}
function aoe(x,y,r,n,push=0){for(const e of s.enemies){const dx=e.x-x,dy=e.y-y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<r+e.r&&e.hp>0){hit(e,n);if(push){e.x+=dx/(d||1)*push;e.y+=dy/(d||1)*push}}}}
function nearest(x,y,range){let best=null,dist=range;for(const e of s.enemies){const d=Math.hypot(e.x-x,e.y-y);if(e.hp>0&&d<dist){best=e;dist=d}}return best}
function shoot(x,y,e,n,pierce,c){if(!e||s.bullets.length>130)return;const a=Math.atan2(e.y-y,e.x-x);s.bullets.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*520,vy:Math.sin(a)*520,n,pierce,c,life:1.6,hit:new Set()})}
// Refurbished laptop: classify, collect, repair and recycle.
function effect(kind,data,life=.45){if(s.fx.length<100)s.fx.push({kind,...data,life,max:life})}
function sector(r,angle,spread,n,push,c){
 effect('sector',{x:s.x,y:s.y,r,angle,spread,c});
 for(const e of s.enemies){const dx=e.x-s.x,dy=e.y-s.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle));
 if(e.hp>0&&d<r+e.r&&Math.abs(delta)<=spread/2+Math.asin(Math.min(1,e.r/(d||1)))){hit(e,n);e.sorted=1.1;if(push){e.x+=dx/(d||1)*push;e.y+=dy/(d||1)*push}}}
}
function updateRecycling(dt){
 for(const e of s.enemies)e.sorted=Math.max(0,(e.sorted||0)-dt);
 for(const z of s.recycling){z.delay-=dt;if(z.delay>0||z.done)continue;z.done=true;
 if(z.kind==='compress'){sfx('compress');for(const e of s.enemies)if(e.hp>0&&Math.abs(e.x-z.x)<z.r+e.r&&Math.abs(e.y-z.y)<z.r+e.r)hit(e,z.n);effect('compress',{x:z.x,y:z.y,r:z.r,c:'#b6f36b'},.35)}
 else {sfx('solar');aoe(z.x,z.y,z.r,z.n,8);ring(z.x,z.y,z.r,'#ffe89a')}}
 s.recycling=s.recycling.filter(z=>!z.done);
}
function weapons(dt){
 const mul=1+(s.items.cpu||0)*.18,range=1+(s.items.control||0)*.15,cd=.85*(1-(s.items.cool||0)*.1);
 for(const k of Object.keys(s.items)){if(defs[k].kind!=='w')continue;const lv=s.items[k],ev=!!s.evolved[k],power=mul*(ev?1.9:1);s.cool[k]=(s.cool[k]||0)-dt;if(s.cool[k]>0)continue;
 const target=nearest(s.x,s.y,600*range);if(target&&k!=='compress')sfx(({laser:'scan',pulse:'solar'})[k]||k);const angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-s.y,target.x-s.x):0;
 if(k==='laser'){sector((180+lv*18)*range,angle,ev?Math.PI*2:Math.PI*.72,(13+lv*5)*power,0,'#a8f599');s.cool[k]=Math.max(.4,1.05-lv*.08)*cd}
 if(k==='fan'){sector((120+lv*14)*range,angle,ev?Math.PI*2:Math.PI*.95,(10+lv*5)*power,ev?65:38,'#a8e6db');s.cool[k]=1.5*cd}
 if(k==='magnet'){const r=(100+lv*10)*(ev?1.35:1)*range;for(const e of s.enemies){const dx=s.x-e.x,dy=s.y-e.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(e.hp>0&&d<r+e.r){hit(e,(2+lv)*power);const pull=Math.min(Math.max(0,d-55),ev?11:6)*(e.boss?.25:1);e.x+=dx/(d||1)*pull;e.y+=dy/(d||1)*pull}}s.cool[k]=.3*cd}
 if(k==='compress'){const r=(48+lv*6)*range;const candidates=s.enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&Math.hypot(e.x-s.x,e.y-s.y)<520*range);const ranked=candidates.map(e=>({e,count:candidates.filter(o=>Math.abs(o.x-e.x)<r&&Math.abs(o.y-e.y)<r).length})).sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count);const centers=[];for(const {e} of ranked){if(centers.every(o=>Math.hypot(e.x-o.x,e.y-o.y)>r*1.5)){centers.push(e);s.recycling.push({kind:'compress',x:e.x,y:e.y,r,n:(35+lv*12)*power,delay:.7});if(centers.length>=(ev?3:1))break}}s.cool[k]=2.8*cd}
 if(k==='network'){const seen=new Set();let fronts=[{x:s.x,y:s.y}];const limit=ev?12:3+lv;for(let step=0;step<limit&&fronts.length;step++){const next=[];for(const from of fronts){const targets=s.enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&!seen.has(e.id)&&Math.hypot(e.x-from.x,e.y-from.y)<(step?180:420)*range).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-from.x,a.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-from.x,b.y-from.y));for(const e of targets.slice(0,ev?2:1)){if(seen.size>=limit)break;seen.add(e.id);hit(e,(13+lv*5)*power);beam(from.x,from.y,e.x,e.y,'#91e5e0');next.push(e)}}fronts=next}s.cool[k]=1.8*cd}
 if(k==='pulse'){const r=(135+lv*19)*range;aoe(s.x,s.y,r,(22+lv*10)*power,10);ring(s.x,s.y,r,'#ffe89a');if(ev)for(let j=1;j<=2;j++)s.recycling.push({kind:'solar',x:s.x,y:s.y,r:r*(1+j*.18),n:(22+lv*10)*power*.65,delay:j*.32});s.cool[k]=3.2*cd}
 if(k==='drone'){const count=ev?6:2+Math.floor(lv/2),targets=s.enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&Math.hypot(e.x-s.x,e.y-s.y)<480*range).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-s.x,a.y-s.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-s.x,b.y-s.y));for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const a=s.t*1.4+j*Math.PI*2/count,x=s.x+Math.cos(a)*65,y=s.y+Math.sin(a)*65,e=targets[j%targets.length];if(e&&e.hp>0){hit(e,(8+lv*4)*power);beam(x,y,e.x,e.y,'#ffd28e')}}s.cool[k]=.95*cd}
 if(k==='shred'){if(target&&s.bullets.length<180){const count=2+Math.floor(lv/2)+(ev?2:0),spread=ev?.95:.70;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const a=angle+(j-(count-1)/2)*spread/Math.max(1,count-1);s.bullets.push({x:s.x+Math.cos(a)*24,y:s.y+Math.sin(a)*24,vx:Math.cos(a)*520,vy:Math.sin(a)*520,life:1.15,n:(12+lv*5)*power,pierce:ev?4:2,hit:new Set(),c:'#f1d57c'});}}s.cool[k]=1.5*cd}
 if(k==='disc'){const count=ev?6:2+Math.floor(lv/2),orbit=(85+lv*9)*(ev?1.15:1)*range;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const a=s.t*2.9+j*Math.PI*2/count;aoe(s.x+Math.cos(a)*orbit,s.y+Math.sin(a)*orbit,ev?22:16,(7+lv*4)*power)}s.cool[k]=.32*cd}
 if(k==='seed'){if(target&&s.bullets.length<180){const count=ev?3:(lv>=4?2:1);for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const a=angle+(j-(count-1)/2)*.38;s.bullets.push({x:s.x,y:s.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*330,vy:Math.sin(a)*330,life:1.7,n:(15+lv*6)*power,pierce:1,blast:(43+lv*10)*(ev?1.2:1)*range,hit:new Set(),c:'#91f5a1',seed:true});}}s.cool[k]=2.25*cd}
 }
}
function update(dt){if(mode!=='play')return;s.t=Math.min(WIN_TIME,s.t+dt);if(s.t>=WIN_TIME){finish(true);hud();return}s.inv-=dt;const x=(keys.d||keys.ArrowRight?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.ArrowLeft?1:0)+joy.x,y=(keys.s||keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.ArrowUp?1:0)+joy.y,len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(x,y));s.x+=x/len*215*dt;s.y+=y/len*215*dt;s.spawn-=dt;if(s.spawn<=0){const count=2+Math.floor(s.t/90);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const types=[0,7,8,9,10,11];spawn(types[Math.floor(Math.random()*types.length)])}s.spawn=Math.max(.3,.6-s.t*.0009)}if(s.t>=60&&!s.boss1){s.boss1=true;spawn(5,true)}if(s.t>=300&&!s.boss2){s.boss2=true;spawn(6,true)}const phase=Math.floor(s.t/90);if(phase>s.phase){s.phase=phase;tell(['','오염 확산 · 몬스터 체력과 공격력 증가! 새로운 장비로 맞서세요.','오염 심화 · 몬스터가 한층 강해졌습니다. 스킬을 강화하세요.','최종 방어 단계 · 강력한 적이 몰려옵니다. 센터를 지켜주세요.'][phase])}
for(const e of s.enemies){if(e.hp<=0)continue;e.hit-=dt;e.tick+=dt;e.hazard+=dt;let dx=s.x-e.x,dy=s.y-e.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;if(!e.boss&&d>Math.hypot(W,H)+400){const a=Math.random()*6.283;e.x=s.x+Math.cos(a)*(Math.hypot(W,H)/2+80);e.y=s.y+Math.sin(a)*(Math.hypot(W,H)/2+80);continue}if(e.type===11){if(e.shock>0){e.shock=Math.max(0,e.shock-dt);if(e.shock===0){if(d<500)sfx('shock');s.fx.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,r:78,life:.35,max:.35,c:'#ffe36a',kind:'ring'});if(d<88){damage(12);if(mode!=='play')return}}}else if(e.hazard>4.5&&d<230){e.shock=.9;e.hazard=0}}if((e.type===3||e.type===10||e.boss)&&e.tick>(e.type===10?3.8:3)&&e.charge<=0){if(d<500)sfx('charge');e.charge=.95;e.dx=dx/d;e.dy=dy/d;e.tick=0}if(e.charge>0){e.charge=Math.max(0,e.charge-dt);if(e.charge<.55){if(e.type===10)e.roll+=(e.dx<0?-1:1)*14*dt;e.x+=e.dx*(e.boss?200:230)*dt;e.y+=e.dy*(e.boss?200:230)*dt}}else if(!(e.type===11&&e.shock>0)){e.x+=dx/d*e.v*1.2*(1+s.t/840)*dt;e.y+=dy/d*e.v*1.2*(1+s.t/840)*dt}if((e.type===4||e.boss)&&e.hazard>3.8&&s.zones.length<30){s.zones.push({x:e.boss?s.x:e.x,y:e.boss?s.y:e.y,r:e.boss?65:36,age:0,life:5});e.hazard=0}if(d<e.r+15){damage(e.boss?22:10);if(mode!=='play')return}}
weapons(dt);updateRecycling(dt);for(const b of s.bullets){b.life-=dt;const ox=b.x,oy=b.y;b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;for(const e of s.enemies){if(e.hp<=0||b.hit.has(e.id))continue;const vx=b.x-ox,vy=b.y-oy,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((e.x-ox)*vx+(e.y-oy)*vy)/(vx*vx+vy*vy||1)));if(Math.hypot(e.x-ox-vx*t,e.y-oy-vy*t)<e.r+(b.seed?7:4)){if(b.seed){aoe(e.x,e.y,b.blast,b.n);ring(e.x,e.y,b.blast,'#a5f6ad');}else hit(e,b.n);b.hit.add(e.id);if(--b.pierce<=0){b.life=0;break}}}}s.bullets=s.bullets.filter(b=>b.life>0);s.enemies=s.enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0);
const pickup=76*(1+(s.items.pickup||0)*.35)+(s.evolved.magnet?55:0);for(const g of s.gems){const dx=s.x-g.x,dy=s.y-g.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<pickup||g.attract){g.attract=true;g.x+=dx/(d||1)*Math.min(d,430*dt);g.y+=dy/(d||1)*Math.min(d,430*dt);if(d<16){s.xp+=g.v;s.collected+=g.v;sfx('collect');g.dead=true}}}s.gems=s.gems.filter(g=>!g.dead);for(const z of s.zones){z.age+=dt;if(z.age>.9&&Math.hypot(s.x-z.x,s.y-z.y)<z.r+10){damage(6);if(mode!=='play')return}}s.zones=s.zones.filter(z=>z.age<z.life);
for(const d of s.drops){if(Math.hypot(s.x-d.x,s.y-d.y)<40){d.dead=true;s.hp=Math.min(s.maxhp,s.hp+(d.type==='box'?35:18));if(d.type==='box'){const owned=available().filter(k=>s.items[k]);if(owned.length){const k=owned[Math.floor(Math.random()*owned.length)];s.items[k]++;if(k==='power'){s.maxhp+=25;s.hp=Math.min(s.maxhp,s.hp+25)}checkEvolution();tell('부품 상자 · '+defs[k].name+' 강화 + 내구도 회복')}else tell('부품 상자 · 내구도 회복')}else sfx('repair')}}s.drops=s.drops.filter(d=>!d.dead);for(const f of s.fx)f.life-=dt;s.fx=s.fx.filter(f=>f.life>0);levelup();hud()}
function hud(){if(!s)return;$('hptext').textContent='내구도 '+Math.ceil(s.hp)+' / '+s.maxhp;$('hpbar').style.width=Math.max(0,s.hp/s.maxhp*100)+'%';$('clock').textContent=time(s.t);$('progress').textContent=Math.floor(s.t/3.6)+'%';$('restorebar').style.width=s.t/3.6+'%';$('kills').textContent='폐기물 처리 '+s.kills;const mult=combatScale();$('threat').textContent='오염 단계 '+(Math.floor(s.t/60)+1)+' · 적 체력 ×'+mult.hp.toFixed(1)+' / 공격력 ×'+mult.attack.toFixed(1);$('level').textContent='LV. '+s.lv+' · 회수 자원 '+s.xp+' / '+s.need;$('xp').firstElementChild.style.width=Math.min(100,s.xp/s.need*100)+'%';const markup=Object.keys(s.items).map(k=>'<span class="chip '+(s.evolved[k]?'evolved':'')+'">'+(s.evolved[k]?'◆ '+defs[k].evo:defs[k].name)+' '+s.items[k]+'/'+defs[k].max+'</span>').join('');if($('equipment').innerHTML!==markup)$('equipment').innerHTML=markup}
function rect(x,y,w,h,c){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h)}function circle(x,y,r,c){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
function laptop(x,y,scale=1){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(s&&s.inv>0&&Math.floor(s.t*12)%2)ctx.globalAlpha=.65;if(playerSprite.complete&&playerSprite.naturalWidth>0){const h=68*scale,w=h*playerSprite.naturalWidth/playerSprite.naturalHeight;ctx.drawImage(playerSprite,-w/2,-h/2,w,h);}else{circle(0,0,18,'#e58b45');circle(-6,-3,2,'#172a27');circle(6,-3,2,'#172a27');}ctx.restore()}function enemy(e){ctx.save();ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.fillStyle=e.hit>0?'#fff':['#73ada0','#b49abd','#b6b8a5','#ce946e','#b5ad68','#c48d5e','#b09675'][e.type];ctx.strokeStyle='#172a27';ctx.lineWidth=3;const r=e.r;const box=e.type===7&&boxSprite.complete&&boxSprite.naturalWidth>0;const bag=e.type===5&&e.boss&&bagBossSprite.complete&&bagBossSprite.naturalWidth>0;const soju=e.type===8&&sojuSprite.complete&&sojuSprite.naturalWidth>0;const cola=e.type===9&&colaSprite.complete&&colaSprite.naturalWidth>0;const robot=e.type===6&&e.boss&&robotSprite.complete&&robotSprite.naturalWidth>0;const pet=e.type===0&&petSprite.complete&&petSprite.naturalWidth>0;const tire=e.type===10&&tireSprite.complete&&tireSprite.naturalWidth>0;const battery=e.type===11&&batterySprite.complete&&batterySprite.naturalWidth>0;if(battery){const height=r*3.4,width=height*batterySprite.naturalWidth/batterySprite.naturalHeight;ctx.save();if(e.hit>0||(e.shock>0&&Math.floor(e.shock*12)%2===0))ctx.globalAlpha=.5;ctx.drawImage(batterySprite,-width/2,-height/2,width,height);ctx.restore();if(e.shock>0){ctx.strokeStyle='#ffe36a';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.setLineDash([5,5]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,78,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);}}else if(tire){const width=r*3.6,height=width*tireSprite.naturalHeight/tireSprite.naturalWidth;ctx.save();ctx.rotate(e.roll||0);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;if(e.hit>0)ctx.globalAlpha=.55;ctx.drawImage(tireSprite,-width/2,-height/2,width,height);ctx.restore();}else if(pet){const width=r*3.35,height=width*petSprite.naturalHeight/petSprite.naturalWidth;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;if(e.hit>0)ctx.globalAlpha=.55;ctx.drawImage(petSprite,-width/2,-height/2,width,height);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}else if(robot){const const sprites={0:[petSprite,3.35],7:[boxSprite,3.25],8:[sojuSprite,2.45],9:[colaSprite,2.05],5:[bagBossSprite,2.4],6:[robotSprite,3.6],10:[tireSprite,3.6]};
const spec=sprites[e.type];let half=e.r;

const barY=-half-12;
if(e.boss){rect(-40,barY,80,5,'#22362c');rect(-40,barY,80*Math.max(0,e.hp/e.max),5,'#efb677')}
const name=({0:'페트병 괴물',7:'종이박스 괴물',8:'소주병 괴물',9:'콜라 괴물',10:'폐타이어 괴물',11:'폐건전지 괴물',5:'비닐봉지 괴물',6:'폐기물 집게 로봇'})[e.type]||'폐기물 괴물';
ctx.font=(e.boss?'bold 12':'11')+'px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';const nameY=barY-(e.boss?13:0),labelWidth=ctx.measureText(name).width+12;
rect(-labelWidth/2,nameY-9,labelWidth,18,'#0b191de0');ctx.fillStyle=e.boss?'#ffe0ac':'#e4f4df';ctx.fillText(name,0,nameY);

function draw(){ctx.setTransform(D,0,0,D,0,0);const t=s?s.t:0,px=s?s.x:0,py=s?s.y:0;ctx.fillStyle=t>180?'#20382f':'#172c2b';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.save();ctx.translate(W/2-px,H/2-py);const left=px-W/2,top=py-H/2;ctx.strokeStyle='#82916c12';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let x=Math.floor(left/64)*64;x<left+W+64;x+=64){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,top);ctx.lineTo(x,top+H);ctx.stroke()}for(let y=Math.floor(top/64)*64;y<top+H+64;y+=64){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(left,y);ctx.lineTo(left+W,y);ctx.stroke()}for(let gx=Math.floor(left/320);gx<(left+W)/320;gx++){for(let gy=Math.floor(top/320);gy<(top+H)/320;gy++){let x=gx*320+40,y=gy*320+40;rect(x,y,90,55,'#0e2325');rect(x+4,y+4,82,47,t>90?'#365046':'#263a38');for(let k=0;k<3;k++)rect(x+12+k*25,y+15,17,18,t>90?'#71ad72':'#43544c');rect(x+6,y+45,78,4,'#718270');if(t>180){circle(x+140,y+20,16,'#416545');rect(x+137,y+20,5,20,'#5f7050');circle(x+140,y+14,12,'#759357')}else{rect(x+141,y+25,13,8,'#49544a');rect(x+160,y+32,8,12,'#3f514a')}}}ctx.strokeStyle='#9db86618';ctx.lineWidth=14;ctx.strokeRect(-180,-120,360,240);ctx.fillStyle='#a0b49a45';ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('RE:BOOT / RESOURCE CENTER',0,-140);
if(s){for(const z of s.zones){circle(z.x,z.y,z.r,z.age<.9?'#edc58b18':'#afaa5340');ctx.strokeStyle=z.age<.9?'#e8bd79':'#aba764';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(z.x,z.y,z.r,0,6.283);ctx.stroke()}for(const g of s.gems){ctx.save();ctx.translate(g.x,g.y);ctx.rotate(Math.PI/4);rect(-4,-4,g.v>4?10:7,g.v>4?10:7,g.v>4?'#f1ce79':'#a5ec8e');ctx.restore()}for(const d of s.drops){rect(d.x-11,d.y-11,22,22,d.type==='box'?'#f1c877':'#a6d6c6');rect(d.x-7,d.y-2,14,4,'#254a36');if(d.type!=='box')rect(d.x-2,d.y-7,4,14,'#254a36')}for(const e of s.enemies)enemy(e);for(const b of s.bullets){ctx.strokeStyle=b.c;ctx.lineWidth=b.seed?7:4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(b.x-b.vx*.025,b.y-b.vy*.025);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.stroke()}if(s.items.magnet){const r=(100+s.items.magnet*10)*(s.evolved.magnet?1.35:1)*(1+(s.items.control||0)*.15);circle(px,py,r,'#a8efb00c');ctx.strokeStyle='#99dfb555';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.setLineDash([8,12]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([])}
for(const z of s.recycling)if(z.kind==='compress'){ctx.fillStyle='#b6f36b18';ctx.fillRect(z.x-z.r,z.y-z.r,z.r*2,z.r*2);ctx.strokeStyle='#b6f36b';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(z.x-z.r,z.y-z.r,z.r*2,z.r*2);ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#e3ffbb';ctx.fillText('자원 압축 준비',z.x,z.y)}
if(s.items.drone){const count=s.evolved.drone?6:2+Math.floor(s.items.drone/2);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const a=t*1.4+i*6.283/count,x=px+Math.cos(a)*65,y=py+Math.sin(a)*65;rect(x-9,y-5,18,10,'#b9c9b0');rect(x-15,y-8,9,3,'#f3d083');rect(x+6,y-8,9,3,'#f3d083')}}
if(s.items.disc){const count=s.evolved.disc?6:2+Math.floor(s.items.disc/2),orbit=(85+s.items.disc*9)*(s.evolved.disc?1.15:1)*(1+(s.items.control||0)*.15);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const a=t*2.9+i*6.283/count,x=px+Math.cos(a)*orbit,y=py+Math.sin(a)*orbit;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(a+t*9);ctx.fillStyle='#b6f36b';ctx.fillRect(-14,-4,28,8);ctx.fillStyle='#d9f5cb';ctx.fillRect(-4,-14,8,28);ctx.fillStyle='#315a49';ctx.fillRect(-4,-4,8,8);ctx.restore()}}
laptop(px,py,1.15);const hpRatio=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,s.hp/s.maxhp));const hpWidth=62,hpY=py+46;ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#101c1de6';ctx.fillRect(px-hpWidth/2-2,hpY-2,hpWidth+4,10);ctx.fillStyle='#39443d';ctx.fillRect(px-hpWidth/2,hpY,hpWidth,6);ctx.fillStyle=hpRatio>.5?'#b6f36b':hpRatio>.25?'#ffd56b':'#ff6b6b';ctx.fillRect(px-hpWidth/2,hpY,hpWidth*hpRatio,6);ctx.restore();for(const f of s.fx){ctx.globalAlpha=f.life/f.max;ctx.strokeStyle=f.c;ctx.lineWidth=f.kind==='beam'?2:4;ctx.beginPath();if(f.kind==='recycle'){ctx.font='bold 20px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle=f.c;ctx.fillText('♻',f.x,f.y-(1-f.life/f.max)*24)}else if(f.kind==='compress'){const r=f.r*f.life/f.max;ctx.rect(f.x-r,f.y-r,r*2,r*2)}else if(f.kind==='sector'){ctx.moveTo(f.x,f.y);ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,f.r,f.angle-f.spread/2,f.angle+f.spread/2);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=f.c;ctx.globalAlpha*=.16;ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=f.life/f.max}else if(f.kind==='beam'){ctx.moveTo(f.x,f.y);ctx.lineTo(f.tx,f.ty)}else ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,f.r*(1-f.life/f.max*.5),0,6.283);ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1}if(s.t<14){ctx.fillStyle='#d7e9c0';ctx.font='13px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('빛나는 자원을 모아 업그레이드하세요',px,py+65)}}else laptop(0,0,2);ctx.restore()}
function loop(now){document.body.classList.toggle("playing",mode==="play");const dt=last?Math.max(0,(now-last)/1000):0;last=now;if(dt>1&&mode==='play'){pause()}else{let remaining=Math.min(dt,.25);while(remaining>0&&mode==='play'){const step=Math.min(.025,remaining);update(step);remaining-=step}}if(mode==='play'&&toastTime>0){toastTime-=dt;if(toastTime<=0)$('toast').hidden=true}updateMusic();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const k=e.key.length===1?e.key.toLowerCase():e.key;if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(k)&&mode==='play')e.preventDefault();if(k==='Escape'&&!e.repeat)pause();if(mode==='upgrade'&&['1','2','3'].includes(k)&&!e.repeat)choose(+k-1);if(mode==='play')keys[k]=true;if(e.key==='Tab'&&mode!=='play'){const els=[...$('overlay').querySelectorAll('button:not(:disabled),select')];if(els.length){const first=els[0],last=els[els.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus()}}}});addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.length===1?e.key.toLowerCase():e.key]=false);addEventListener('blur',()=>{clearKeys();if(mode==='play')pause()});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&mode==='play')pause()});$('pause').onclick=pause;$('sound').onclick=()=>{setSound(!sound);if(sound)sfx('collect')};document.querySelectorAll('[data-key]').forEach(b=>{b.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);if(mode==='play')keys[b.dataset.key]=true};b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=b.onlostpointercapture=()=>keys[b.dataset.key]=false});canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(mode!=='play'||e.pointerType==='mouse'||joy.id!==null)return;e.preventDefault();joy.id=e.pointerId;joy.ox=e.clientX;joy.oy=e.clientY;const j=$('joystick');j.classList.add('active');const r=j.getBoundingClientRect();j.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-r.width,joy.ox-r.width/2))+'px';j.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerHeight-r.height,joy.oy-r.height/2))+'px';j.style.bottom='auto';try{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch{}});canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId!==joy.id||mode!=='play')return;e.preventDefault();const dx=e.clientX-joy.ox,dy=e.clientY-joy.oy,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy),r=42,f=dist<5?0:Math.min(1,(dist-5)/(r-5));joy.x=dist?dx/dist*f:0;joy.y=dist?dy/dist*f:0;$('stick').style.transform=`translate(calc(-50% + ${joy.x*32}px),calc(-50% + ${joy.y*32}px))`});for(const event of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])canvas.addEventListener(event,e=>{if(e.pointerId===joy.id)resetJoy()});canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script></body></html>
